about: R27e (2026-10-20; D-SRC-42, D-SRC-50, D-SRC-51), re-levelled by R28e and R28a the same day: every sentence of the no-write notice, verbatim, for one path. `start` holds every reason a block at the START can carry and `midSession` every reason a block that begins after a load can carry (the load kinds: Model.stateLoadDecision blocks mid-session with the load kind itself). The two differ in the second sentence only (R28e: what becomes of a change made now). R28a withdrew read-timeout, and R29a (which withdrew R28a's held save and its "Saving is waiting" notice) kept it withdrawn: a read that does not answer within 2 s is no block, its save is written without it. tests/Model.test.js holds Model.stateUnreadableNotice, stateUnreadableJournal and stateBlockedHeader to it, both ways, and pins each way back out of a mid-session block to the sentence that names it. The README and docs/UX-SOURCES.md quote these words.

unsaved.start: Sources, favorites and settings changed now are not kept.
unsaved.midSession: Favorites and other changes made now are held in this session only: the next such change made here saves them if it finds the file again, but they are dropped if the file comes back by itself first, if a source change is what finds it, or if the shell is stopped.

linkFirst: If it is a symbolic link, point it back at the folder or file that holds your state
